title: Lior and the Sigil
premise: Oscar Kavanagh, the crown's food-taster, has survived poison and smugglers' roads alike by knowing exactly who he is: a nobody with a useful body. When a dying courier named Lior presses a blood-marked map into his hands and dies whispering about the Sigil, Oscar discovers the map is a prison for an ancient power that once shattered the Thornfell kingdoms — and the royal court will kill to claim it. Hunted by the king's spymaster and haunted by memories that aren't his own bleeding in through Lior's blood, Oscar must choose between surrendering the map to a corrupt crown, destroying it and erasing Lior's last legacy, or claiming the Sigil himself. In the end Oscar shatters the Sigil at the cost of his own memories of Lior, freeing the mountains from an ancient war no one living remembers — and keeping only a name he can no longer place.
about_author: S. M. Okonkwo is the pen name of a former archivist who spent a decade cataloguing medieval trade routes and poison trials before turning to fiction. They write fantasy about ordinary people carrying impossible burdens, from a small house at the edge of the mountains.

chapters.title: The Taster's Tongue
chapters.summary: POV Oscar. Establishes Oscar's careful, self-erasing life at court: tasting the prince's food, cataloguing smuggler routes he's never allowed to travel, invisible by design. A courier is arrested in the kitchens and Oscar recognizes the Thornfell brand on his cloak. Emotional beat: the ache of a man built to be unnoticed, wanting more.

chapters.title: Blood on the Map
chapters.summary: POV Oscar. The dying courier — Lior — escapes his cell and collapses into Oscar's storeroom, pressing a blood-streaked map into his hands and a warning into his ears before dying. The spymaster Veyra arrives minutes later; Oscar lies for the first time in his life. Emotional beat: terror and exhilaration as the invisible man becomes a fugitive.

chapters.title: The Road He Was Never Allowed
chapters.summary: POV Oscar, with interludes of Lior's memories surfacing through the blood on Oscar's hands. Oscar flees into the Thornfell passes he knows only from ledgers, guided now by Lior's borrowed memories of the real roads. Veyra's hunters close in. Emotional beat: wonder curdling into fear as the memories stop feeling borrowed.

chapters.title: What Lior Remembered
chapters.summary: POV alternating Oscar and Lior's past, told through the Sigil's seeping memories: Lior was a Sigil-keeper, last of an order sworn to keep the map sealed, and the court's own mages betrayed the order. Oscar realizes the king's court started the hunt. Emotional beat: grief for a stranger he is becoming, and rage at the crown.

chapters.title: The Smuggler's Price
chapters.summary: POV Oscar. Oscar bargains passage with smuggler captain Ashka Vey, who recognizes the map's mark and names a brutal price: the Sigil's location if they're caught. Veyra captures Ashka's second-in-command and turns him. Emotional beat: Oscar learning that trust, not immunity, is what keeps him alive.

chapters.title: The Court of Broken Oaths
chapters.summary: POV Veyra. The spymaster's chapters reveal the court's rot: the king's mages want the Sigil to reignite the old war and reforge the shattered kingdom under absolute rule. Veyra, herself a former Sigil-keeper's daughter, begins to doubt. Emotional beat: the antagonist's conscience cracking — power corrupting even the loyal.

chapters.title: Where the Map Ends
chapters.summary: POV Oscar. Oscar and Ashka reach the sealed vault beneath Thornfell's spine, but the Sigil speaks to Oscar directly, offering him Lior's complete memory — and the power to never be a nobody again. Betrayed by the turned smuggler, Ashka is wounded covering his escape into the vault. Emotional beat: temptation at its peak; Oscar nearly says yes.

chapters.title: The Sigil's Bargain
chapters.summary: POV Oscar, deep in the vault. The Sigil shows Oscar the ancient war entire — and shows him that Lior died choosing to seal it rather than wield it. Veyra arrives, blade drawn, but cannot kill the son of the order she betrayed by inheritance. Emotional beat: Oscar's identity crisis resolved — he chooses to be Lior's heir, not the Sigil's master.

chapters.title: Shatter
chapters.summary: POV Oscar and Veyra. The mages breach the vault; Veyra turns her blades on her own king's men to buy Oscar the moment he needs. Oscar breaks the Sigil — the price is every memory the blood gave him, and every memory of Lior with it. The vault collapses as the ancient power disperses into the mountains. Emotional beat: triumphant devastation.

chapters.title: A Name He Cannot Place
chapters.summary: POV Oscar, epilogue. Oscar returns to a changed court under a weakened crown, resumes tasting — and finds a carved name on his storeroom door in his own handwriting: Lior. He doesn't know why it makes him weep. Ashka rides for Thornfell to rebuild what the order lost. Emotional beat: bittersweet resolution — memory lost, identity chosen.
